title: Netlist patent rulings were affirmed or left in an active appeal involving Micron
canonical_summary: PTAB and Federal Circuit materials described invalidation of challenged Netlist patent claims and Micron's continued procedural position in the appeal.
known_event_summary: 2026-09-02 Netlist patent milestone: the Federal Circuit/Patent Office rulings invalidated challenged Netlist patents while Micron remained the sole appellee in the appeal.

facts.proposition: Patent Office and Federal Circuit rulings invalidated challenged Netlist patent claims in the Micron-related matter.
Micron Technology Inc. remained the sole appellee in the appeal.
